findings.title: Better return treated as an unearned finding
findings.claim: The garden owner treats a better return as something he will simply find, projecting the present property's advantage into the final destination without a stated work or transformation path.
findings.mechanism: The focus pairs the emphatic finding carrier أَجِدَنَّ with the return-place/result carrier مُنقَلَبًا. Deed-grounded finding and recorded judgment in 2:110 and 18:49, together with return-to-the-Lord parallels in 7:125 and 41:50, make the missing route of formation and change materially visible.
findings.reader_payoff: The boast becomes legible as a causal shortcut: possession is treated as proof that the same or a better outcome will be found later.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that he expects to find a better place on return. This adds the global entitlement and copied-possession resonance without making the focus verb mean entitlement or denying the reality of return.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers, branch glosses, and trusted cross-run record are exact; the transformation check is also reported by legacy_unbound reader-walk evidence, so the integrated relation remains qualified rather than fully grounded.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bulma ve duyusal ya da zihinsel olarak algılama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi, özellikle arananı veya yitiği, bulmak ve ona erişmek.
branch_activations.carrier: أَجِدَنَّ carries the ordinary act of finding or obtaining an object, not creating the object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The packet's 2:110 and 18:49 contacts tie what is found or made present with God to deeds already advanced and recorded; that deed relation is separate from the focus occurrence.
branch_activations.activation: The finding carrier contacts a wider deed-and-record frame, so the promised good is read as an outcome claimed without the work that would ordinarily ground finding it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The speaker makes the better outcome look discoverable as an entitlement rather than formed through an accountable route.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual resonance of finding; it does not replace the ordinary meaning of finding or assert that the verb itself lexically means entitlement.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yerden veya durumdan dönme, ayrılma ya da geri yönelmedir.

branch_activations.activation: The focus's return movement contacts wider passages where the Lord-directed return is explicit, making the speaker's favorable destination a claim that needs more than present prosperity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The asserted better destination is not merely a place of arrival; it is the future result the speaker assumes he can claim.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation keeps the return event in view and adds its entitlement pressure; it does not deny the ordinary destination reading.

branch_activations.activation: The destination facet contacts that wider frame and changes the comparison from a garden's present quality to the speaker's presumed final outcome.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The future result is imagined as better by continuity with the current property, even though the packet's wider return contacts attach outcomes to a larger accountability frame.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the destination/result facet as a contextual resonance and does not claim a settled theological adjudication of the final outcome.

findings.title: Return projected as a copy
findings.claim: The imagined return carries the present garden's advantage forward as a copy: the destination is called better, but no actual change in the speaker's condition is imagined.
findings.mechanism: The B005 return/destination facets of مُنقَلَبًا contact the B004 change facet, while 18:37 and 18:40 are supplied as the surrounding origin-and-state-change test. The wider return parallels keep the contact in the global lane and expose the projection as extrapolation rather than transformation.
findings.reader_payoff: Return becomes more than relocation: it is the point at which the speaker's refusal to imagine change is tested.
findings.containment: The ordinary return and final-destination reading remains intact. The state-change contact is exploratory and does not assert that the lexical branch itself means irony or that one competing reading displaces another.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and branch facets are supplied exactly, but the origin/state-change evidence comes from legacy_unbound reader-walk records without independent target Arabic in the packet.
